dog.description_text:
🐚 Meet Seashell! 🐚

Seashell arrived at the shelter as a stray, wearing nothing but a little seashell necklace. We don't know much about her past or how she ended up alone, but we do know that this girl has so much love to give. Seashell is now in foster care with Every Last One Rescue.

Seashell is estimated to be 1 year old, and she is just the sweetest soul. She's wiggly, affectionate, and wants nothing more than to love and be loved right back.

Seashell absolutely loves other dogs! She's a respectful and thoughtful playmate who knows how to have fun without being overwhelming. She takes breaks when needed, shares beautifully, and seems to genuinely enjoy the company of having friends around.

She's a little on the skinny side and has some weight to gain, but we're going to make sure she gets all the good food, care, and love she deserves.

We can't wait to watch this sweet girl blossom, get to know all her little quirks, and find the forever family she's been waiting for!
dog.name: Seashell
